hero.title: Your safety beacon at events
hero.sub: StreetPhare secures your journeys during gatherings through a decentralized peer-to-peer (P2P) network, real-time community reporting, and intelligent navigation to safe zones — no central server, no ads, no commercial tracking.

why.title:
Built to protect you,
not to surveil you
why.lead: During public gatherings, information flows poorly, mobile networks get congested, and law enforcement may block access points. StreetPhare addresses these on-the-ground realities.

cards.title: Decentralized Peer-to-Peer Network
cards.desc: Even without internet, StreetPhare maintains a local mesh network via Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) between participants. No central server required to operate.

cards.title: Privacy by Design
cards.desc: No account, no registration. Identifiers are ephemeral and rotating. Zero personal data collected or transmitted. End-to-end encryption. No commercial tracking. Ever.

cards.title: Offline OpenStreetMap Maps
cards.desc: OSM maps are locally embedded. Navigation works entirely offline: route calculation to safe zones, medical centers, emergency exits.

cards.title: Community Reporting
cards.desc: Report and receive in real-time: roadblocks, kettling, danger zones, medical centers. Each report is validated by consensus (≥3 confirmations) before being visible to all.

cards.title: Collective Panic Button
cards.desc: In case of collective emergency, trigger an alert signal instantly propagated to all nearby participants via the P2P mesh, even without internet.

cards.title: 100% Free, Forever
cards.desc: No ads. No in-app purchases. No subscriptions. No monetization of your data. StreetPhare is an activist open-source tool licensed under GPLv3.

items.title: Intelligent Navigation to Safety
items.desc: The map displays real-time danger reports validated by the community, plotted on an OpenStreetMap background with a dark theme optimized for perfect readability even in direct sunlight.
items.img_desc: View your position, community alerts, safe route, and safe zones directly on the high-visibility dark OSM map.
points: Safe Route calculated and displayed with directional arrows
Priority destination: Nearest Safe Zone / Medical Center
Works offline with embedded OSM maps
Compass and GPS optimized (5m threshold to mask oscillations)

items.title: Decentralized Hive Messaging
items.desc: Communicate with other participants via an end-to-end encrypted peer-to-peer messaging system. Messages are propagated over the local BLE mesh without going through any server.
items.img_desc: Exchange encrypted messages with nearby participants, even without internet, via Bluetooth mesh.
points: Blocks & reporting system for unwanted content

items.title: Public Gathering Route Tracking
items.desc: Load an event via QR Code and track the procession in real-time. Waypoints are progressively revealed for operational security reasons. Safe zones, emergency exits, and medical centers are displayed directly on the map.
items.img_desc: Track the gathering point in real-time, progressively revealed waypoints, and secured assembly areas.
points: Safe zones, emergency exits, street medics on the map
Locked tracking if no event loaded (protection)
Autonomous mode if servers unreachable (Pure Hive)

download.title:
Download StreetPhare
on your platform
download.sub: Available on Android, iOS, and Windows Desktop. Completely free, no subscription, no in-app purchases, forever.
download.note: Binaries are compiled from public source code. You can also compile the application yourself from GitHub by following the build instructions.

legal.title: Complete Transparency
legal.lead: StreetPhare is an activist open-source project. All code, documentation, and policies are public and auditable.

cards.title: Privacy Policy
cards.desc: No personal data collected. No tracking server. Identifiers are ephemeral and rotating. No commercial telemetry.

cards.title: GPLv3 License
cards.desc: StreetPhare is distributed under the GNU General Public License v3. You are free to use, study, modify, and redistribute the code.

cards.title: Source Code
cards.desc: All Flutter code, Node.js servers, and technical documentation are publicly available on GitHub.

cards.title: Technical Documentation
cards.desc: P2P architecture, Hive protocol, server setup guide, API and complete developer documentation.

cards.title: About the Project
cards.desc: StreetPhare was born from the concrete need to secure journeys during large events. It's a tool for public gathering participants, by participants.

cards.title: Report a Bug
cards.desc: Found an issue? Report it directly via the app (Bug Report button) or open an issue on GitHub. All contributions welcome.

credits.title:
StreetPhare exists thanks
to these projects
credits.lead: StreetPhare relies on remarkable open-source libraries. Here are the acknowledgements and explicit credits to their authors.

libraries.name: Flutter & Dart SDK
libraries.desc: Multi-platform UI framework (Google). Base of the mobile and desktop application.

libraries.name: flutter_map
libraries.desc: Interactive mapping based on Leaflet.js for Flutter. Display of OSM tiles and data layers.

libraries.name: OsmAnd Core / osmand_flutter
libraries.desc: Routing engine and offline OpenStreetMap map data. Safe Route calculation.

libraries.name: flutter_reactive_ble
libraries.desc: Reactive BLE library for Flutter. Bluetooth Low Energy communication for P2P mesh.

libraries.name: Hive (hive_flutter)
libraries.desc: Lightweight and fast local database for Flutter. Storage of alerts, preferences, and messages.

libraries.name: geolocator
libraries.desc: Cross-platform GPS and geolocation access. Real-time position and distance calculation.

libraries.name: latlong2
libraries.desc: Geodesic calculations (distances, bearings, conversions). Used for navigation and geofences.

libraries.name: flutter_compass
libraries.desc: Hardware compass access. Directional orientation and navigation arrow.

libraries.name: pointycastle / cryptography
libraries.desc: AES-256 encryption, ECDSA signatures, and key derivation. Hive messages and alerts security.

libraries.name: Node.js + Express
libraries.desc: Encrypted relay servers (Port 3000/3001) and web administration dashboard.

libraries.name: OpenStreetMap contributors
libraries.desc: Free and collaborative worldwide map data. Tiles provided by CartoDB / OSM.
